Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (zcode:enrich-mytheme-l3), per scene:
#1 shadow — confrontation staged: repel + shove pointer, turbulence 0.15 (projection's disturbed field); the Christ-image sequence walks triangle → 'privatio boni' → a dimmed triangle (the exclusively luminous image meeting the argument that keeps evil's efficacy in view); the shadow disc grows as the world gives the rejected face back; Antichrist's ☹ brightens from excluded dim to compensatory red-brown. Duration 13.
#2 fishes — THE 3D SCENE. z is the age's layered time: the embracing double nearest (z +0.4, lived), Epiphanius's carried image at z +0.2, Pisces at middle depth (z 0), Leviathan behind (z −0.25), the precessional spring-point deepest (z −0.5, the slow astronomical background); auto-aeon, the journey's slowest sine LFO on circulation (rate 0.05 — the precession's pace). The double's sequence walks ◑◕ dim → ◑◕ bright → ◕ (bound, released, embraced, one); Leviathan's ring splits and becomes the golden disc of meal. Vortex + pulse pointer (the age's slow turning). Duration 14.
#3 alchemy — attraction worked: attract + pulse pointer (the magnet taught); the sea creature's ring heats grey → copper → shining gold; the Echeneis sequence walks 🧲 (the fish that halts ships) → 'magnet' (the operative understanding that draws the substance up) — the record's reversal in its own terms. Duration 13.
#4 quaternio — grid layout: the four states A/B/C/D held in their quadrants; the Anthropos sequence walks A → a → A (the record's own lower-case notation for transformation within the state); the diamonds' ring rotates 0 → 45 → 90 with the gold returning (each whole unfolding into four and passing onward, p.259); vortex + pulse pointer (the opus's circulation). Duration 13.
#5→0 return — the two successions walked ⇉ → generative → historical → ⇉ (what a work makes possible beside how its image becomes an inherited condition); attract at 0.3 — the revisable measure held without forcing; the register decision ⊘ and the uninstantiated ∅ kept exactly as the ledger holds them. Duration 15, the longest beat.
ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: the journey opens with the ego meeting its excluded contrary — the shadow disc growing, the Christ-image dimming through its own argument, Antichrist brightening at the rim — and closes with the same structure at the scale of an age: de-monopolisation names what #1 lived, the inherited image becoming revisable, its exclusions active. The ego's ◉ of #1 returns as the eyewash ◉ of #3 — the same sign changed from centre-of-reference to capacity-to-see — and the dimmed Antichrist of #1 returns as the ⊘ register decision: the contrary held at the occupied slash without being installed. The ending qualifies the record's own line: a person who encounters the larger psychic field still has to judge and act; a culture that recognises the history of its image has acquired a responsibility to that history.
Human-amplified staging: the ledger's four appointments stay exactly as the record holds them — whole-before-fragments human-amplified: yes as design commitment; the exact symbolic appointment, the 1/1′ conjugate and the Pisces/precession appointment human-amplified: no (the #5→0 body and ⊘/∅ entities carry this). Mythemic verbs only: the images demonstrate and transform through the acts staged; no reusable index before the whole.
Automation: auto-aeon (#2, field.params.circulation sine at rate 0.05 — the precession's slow breath), tied to the record's aeonic office. Durations 13–15 and transitions 1.5–2.2: the fishes and the return held longest.

glyph_rationales.the ego — centre of reference, rooted be: the circled dot — the point of reference that does not see its own ground.
glyph_rationales.the shadow — recognised through moral ef: the dark smear beneath the ego — the repudiated traits that return from the world as if encountered outside.
glyph_rationales.the Christ-image — the Self given a huma: the haloed figure — wholeness given a human form; an exclusively luminous image that cannot hold all the opposites.
glyph_rationales.Antichrist — the excluded contrary given: the mirrored figure with a darkened halo — the compensatory counter-image arising within the Christian aeon's own field.
glyph_rationales.the precessional wheel — the spring-poin: the drawn wheel with its star-marks — the astrological image through which the doubled figure acquires duration; the wheel's sequence turns the age.
glyph_rationales.Pisces — the two fishes of the age, head: two drawn fish joined head to tail — contrary tendencies of one age, lived successively.
glyph_rationales.♈: the precessional spring-point in Aries — expectation itself become a historical actor.
glyph_rationales.the Pistis Sophia double — bound, releas: two small figures leaning together — the child-double bound, released and embraced; doubling that ends in reunion, not antagonism.
glyph_rationales.Leviathan — split against itself, then f: the ring divided in its sequence — the monster's conflict within itself ending as nourishment; differentiation of undifferentiated terror.
glyph_rationales.Epiphanius's rite — the image carried up: torches over an underground vault — the Alexandria rite of bearing the image up and returning it; reception already changing the image's office.
glyph_rationales.the round sea creature — heated with sea: the boneless round creature over its brazier — the opacity of the beginning substance, heated toward radiance.
glyph_rationales.the eyewash — the preparation becoming t: the drawn bowl — the preparation's end is an alteration in the practitioner's seeing.
glyph_rationales.the Echeneis reversal — the magnet that: poles with lines of attraction holding the small fish — the worker now draws the power that previously held the vessel; the magnet can be taught.
glyph_rationales.☿: Mercurius — substance and philosophy at once; the lapis hidden within darkness.
glyph_rationales.the aftermath — the instrument inherits: the drawn telescope — science born of the alchemical epoch, inheriting the operation while the condition of its possibility recedes.
glyph_rationales.the connected diamonds — Anthropos, Shad: the four linked diamonds, the second drawn in dashes — A→B→C→D with lower-case transformations, the Shadow Quaternio marked as Jung's declared modern reconstruction.
glyph_rationales.the opus circling — solve et coagula, th: the wide ring around the chain — the circular opus whose return differs from its beginning by the differentiation it carried out.
glyph_rationales.the return changed — an unconscious tota: the light disc at the ring's foot — the round's end point: the same totality, now conscious.
glyph_rationales.de-monopolisation — the inherited image: the ring loosening in its sequence — the governing image exposed as background; the age becomes visible as an age.
glyph_rationales.succession — what a work makes possible: a drawn sprout beside drawn arrows — generative succession (what life a work makes possible) held beside historical succession (what it leaves as inherited condition).
glyph_rationales.⊘: the occupied slash — the register decision placing Christ/Antichrist there, after the native derivation.
glyph_rationales.the unratified — held unassigned until t: empty brackets — the exact symbolic appointments (Christ, Antichrist, fishes, alchemy, aeon) held uninstantiated, proposed not installed.
